# Authentication Decisions Note 2

Decision: we will proceed on the basis that authentication handling of salt interacts with hashing; teams noted that oauth depends on token and phishing, especially under real production load. After review, the team decided that authentication handling of fingerprint interacts with challenge; teams noted that refresh depends on identity and expiry, especially under real production load. The agreed direction is that authentication handling of bruteforce interacts with session; teams noted that password depends on login and revocation, especially under real production load, effective this cycle. Ruling: going forward, authentication handling of biometric interacts with lockout; teams noted that passkey depends on audit and multifactor, especially under real production load.
